# Murman Engineering India Pvt Ltd

> Navi Mumbai firm that helps real estate developers in Maharashtra turn green building certification into additional built-up area under UDCPR, with low-carbon materials, environmental compliance on site and stage-wise quality checks. Founded 2025, building on 35 years of construction delivery by Lalit Enterprises (since 1991; 55+ buildings).

## Services (four bundles)
- Green certification and incentives: IGBC, GRIHA, LEED and EDGE pathways; green FSI under Maharashtra's UDCPR (3 to 7% additional built-up area in Thane, Kalyan-Dombivli, Pune and other UDCPR areas; not Greater Mumbai, which follows DCPR 2034), protected to the occupancy certificate.
- Low-carbon materials and value engineering: bill of quantities review, PSC, GGBS and LC3 concrete, AAC blocks and recycled aggregate at equal or lower cost, supplier sourcing.
- Environmental compliance on site: construction dust and air quality plans, construction and demolition waste plans under the 2025 rules, environmental clearance and six-monthly reports with accredited partners.
- Execution and quality: flooring, tiling, stone and waterproofing by a 35-year team, stage-wise quality checks, handover readiness including rehab homes in redevelopment.
